mapper.select: SELECT CI.ID as id, CI.COUPON_NUMBER as couponNumber, D.NAME as discountName, CI.ISSUED_AT as issuedAt, D.DESCRIPTION as description, D.DISCOUNT_TYPE as discountType, D.DISCOUNT_VALUE as discountValue, D.MAX_DISCOUNT as maxDiscount FROM COUPON_ISSUANCE_TB CI JOIN DISCOUNT_TB D ON CI.DISCOUNT_ID = D.ID WHERE CI.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId} AND CI.USED_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUPON_ISSUANCE_TB CI WHERE CI.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId} AND CI.USED_YN = 'N'
